sources.name: IMAIOS e-Anatomy — Costal notches
sources.excerpt: Costal notches are indentations on the lateral borders of the sternum for the costal cartilages.

sources.name: Kenhub — Sternocostal joints
sources.excerpt: The sternal costal notches appear as shallow, concave depressions on the lateral border of the sternum.

reasoning: Les incisures costales sont des depessions concaves du bord lateral ; leur aspect de profil peut varier.
